text:
maya: Heads up — CI golden prompt for tool invocation is failing intermittently. Getting schema validation 400s and occasional 401s in the same run. Repro below.

sam: Can you paste the failing payload / logs?

maya: Sure, paste of error from ci-runner log:
```
ERROR: tool_call_validation failed: unexpected field "addr" in args at /service/invoke
payload: {"tool":"price_lookup","args":{"sku":"XYZ","addr":"1.2.3.4"}}
HTTP 400
Then later: HTTP 401 token_expired for same test
```

lucas: We just enabled stricter arg schema linting in eval harness last week — could be that selector returned older tool signature that expects `location` not `addr`.

maya: Odd thing: locally `./scripts/run-golden.sh` passes every time. CI only fails ~2-3% of runs and sometimes shows a 401 followed by a billing spike in the trace (multiple retries). Maybe a token refresh race.

chris: Can you repro with curl? post the exact command.

maya: curl snippet used in test harness:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"tool":"price_lookup","args":{"sku":"XYZ","addr":"1.2.3.4"}}'
```

support-bot: Created INC-1234 for escalation (priority P1) — assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime.

sam: Short-term workaround: pin eval runs to model-version=v2.1 and tool-schema-version=2026-02 until we confirm selector compatibility. Also add a retry cap to avoid billing spikes.

maya: Root-cause hypothesis: selector cache returns a mixed set (some workers with new schema, some with old). Combined with token refresh concurrent retries -> malformed args hit strict validator on new workers, old workers accept and call external tool -> duplicate calls and billing.

lucas: I'll run the failing suite on dedicated-staging with a 50k-run fuzz seed and capture selector decisions. Need PR/commit sha.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/3a9f1b2 (added stricter schema lint)

chris: Suggest adding golden variant for the prompt that exercises both schema shapes and then gate the CI on deterministic tool-selection mapping. Also add a small contract test to the tool registry CI that validates compatibility matrix.

sam: I'll add an incremental CI job: `toolcall-regression` that runs against a pinned tool registry snapshot and fails fast if schema drift detected. Also relax the strictness in the golden eval until migration completes.

oncall: Acknowledged — monitoring set up for CI failures and billing anomalies. Forwarding INC-1234 to infra oncall.

maya: Thanks all. Action items: (1) lucas run staging fuzz + capture selector logs; (2) sam add CI job and pin snapshot; (3) chris add contract test; (4) maya follow up on postmortem if it recurs. Tagging @lucas @sam @chris :eyes:
